_comment: Expected parse results for the pinned sidecar fixtures. W3/W4's sum-over-message parser + capture-failed classifier assert against THESE exact values. Token sums are DEDUPED by assistant message.id (a tool-use turn writes >1 JSONL line sharing one message.id, each repeating the identical usage block; naive summing double-counts). token_totals lists each usage class summed independently plus two derived roll-ups so the pipeline can pick its accounting; duration_ms is first-record-timestamp to last-record-timestamp.

naive_undeduped_would_be.note: msg_01B00000000000000000BB appears on 2 lines; a non-deduping parser double-counts it. This row exists so the dedup requirement is pinned, not assumed.

canonical_3turn.jsonl.note: Per-message sidecar records carry NO total_cost_usd / duration_ms (those live only in one-shot -p RESULT envelopes). $ is therefore UNMEASURED on the interactive path unless the engine self-reports costUSD; tokens+time are the measured facts.

engine_switch_combined_A_plus_B._comment: canonical_3turn (segment A) + resumed_segment (segment B), each message counted EXACTLY once via the ledger key (engine_session_uuid, message_uuid). W4's switch-engine invariant test asserts total == A + B with no double-count, including on a re-ingest of the same file.

corrupted_zero_usage.jsonl.note: PRESENT-but-zero is a CORRECTNESS failure per the locked tripwire severity — an atomic state='capture-failed' record (never measured-$0, never silent 'unmeasured'); healthcheck report.check(False) RED.

corrupted_malformed.jsonl.note: A truncated/malformed JSON line raises json.JSONDecodeError. PRESENT-but-unparseable is capture-failed (RED), never $0 and never silent.
